DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このメモの金額で払おうと思いましたが、自分の試算です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 私的試算で納付しようとしたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to pay the amount in this note, but it is my own estimate.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you were going to pay based on a private estimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正式な通知もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you also have the official notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。メモとは別に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 正式通知を別に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Please look at it separately from the note.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the official notice separately in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 試算の元にした資料を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the materials used for your estimate.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 去年の資料です。今年の対象に合うか未確認でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前年資料の適合未確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are last year's materials. I had not checked whether they apply to this year's subject.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not confirmed whether the previous year's materials apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申告や納付の状態はどうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: What is the status of your filing and payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。メモを書いただけで手続き済みとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未申告未納付を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not done either yet. Writing a note does not mean I have completed the procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not filed or paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が対象と現在の状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will check what is covered and your current status.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 不足額を自分で補記せず、正式な案内を聞いてから払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己補記せず担当確認後に払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not add a shortfall myself; I will pay after hearing the official guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not add entries yourself and will pay after the responsible staff confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 試算メモ、通知、前年資料を区別して担当へお渡しください。支払いは確認後に進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give the responsible staff the estimate note, notice, and previous year's materials as separate documents. Payment will proceed after they are checked.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道具の確認は済みましたか。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished checking the tools?

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 泥を拭くと柄に亀裂が見えました。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拭いた後の亀裂を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I wiped off the mud, I could see a crack in the handle.
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the crack found after wiping in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その道具は使いましたか。

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。土を掘って試すこともしません。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用と試用をしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I will not test it by digging soil either.
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have neither used nor tested it.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかと分けて位置を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Keep it separate from the others and tell us its location.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口の確認台へ置きます。番号は四番です。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 識別番号と保管位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put it on the inspection bench at the entrance. Its number is four.
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the identification number and storage location in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 代わりの道具は担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible staff will guide you to a replacement tool.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ形の隣の道具も、点検済みか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 代替品の点検状態を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would also like to check whether the adjacent tool of the same shape has been inspected.
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the replacement's inspection status in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 作業の担当も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us also confirm the work assignment.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は畝の整備です。適した道具を確認してから始めます。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作業用途に合う指示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today's work is preparing the growing beds. I will start after confirming the appropriate tool.
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for instructions suited to the work's purpose.

DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 四番は使用を保留しました。代替道具の点検と畝の担当指示を受けてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Use of number four is on hold. Please have the replacement tool inspected and receive the instructions from the person responsible for the beds.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 購入品についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: You would like advice about a purchase, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 職場で分けた野菜が一袋足りません。店で渡されなかったかはまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 一袋不足と店での不足が未確定であることを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: One bag of vegetables was missing when we distributed them at work. I do not yet know whether the shop failed to give it to us.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that one bag is missing but a shortage at the shop is not confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 購入数が分かるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you have anything showing the quantity purchased?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: レシートには八袋とあります。三人には二袋ずつ渡しましたが、最後の人には一袋しかありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: レシートの購入数と配布した内訳を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: The receipt says eight bags. I gave two bags each to three people, but there was only one for the last person.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State the receipt's purchased quantity and the distribution breakdown in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 配る前に袋数を数えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Did you count the bags before distributing them?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 数えていません。車から運んだ人も別なので、渡された数と配った数を同じとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 配布前の未計数と運搬者が別であることを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: No. Someone else carried them from the car too, so I will not assume the number handed over and the number distributed are the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you did not count before distribution and someone else carried them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 運んだ方と配布先へ確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Can you check with the person who carried them and the recipients?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。車に残っていないか聞き、受け取った人にも実際の袋数を確認します。レシートの数量は消しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 運搬者と受取人へ現物数を照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I will ask whether any remained in the car and confirm the actual number with each recipient too. I will not erase the quantity on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask the carrier and recipients about the actual quantities in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらでは購入時の記録を確認できます。返金をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can check the purchase records here. Are you requesting a refund?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: まだ返金の依頼ではありません。こちらで確認できる記録と、職場で確認する配布数を分けて調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 返金の要求でなく購入記録と配布数の照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I am not requesting a refund yet. I want to investigate separately the records you can check here and the number distributed that we will check at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that this is not a refund request but a request to compare purchase records and distributed quantities.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 購入記録の確認を担当へ取り次ぎます。車内と配布先で分かった数量も、同じ購入の相談として後からお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will pass the purchase-record inquiry to the responsible staff. Please later tell us the quantities found in the car and with the recipients as part of this same purchase inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 飾り付けの準備ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: このひもと線をまとめて引いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ひもと配線の混在を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: May I pull this cord and these wires together?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the mixture of cords and wiring.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 電気の線もあります。触らず担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Some are electrical wires. Do not touch them; we will ask the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。飾り用のひもだけを区別したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未接触で識別を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have not touched them yet. I want to distinguish only the decorative cord.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not touched them and request identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 配線担当が位置を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The wiring staff will show you where they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 照明が消えていても線を動かしてよいとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 消灯と取扱許可を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will not assume I may move the wires just because the lights are off.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish lights being off from permission to handle wiring in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日はどの範囲の飾りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Which area are you decorating today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 入口の横です。柱の上までは担当していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 装飾担当の範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Beside the entrance. I am not responsible for the top of the pillar.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State the limits of your decoration assignment in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 担当範囲の取付場所を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will show you the attachment points within your assigned area.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 範囲外の線と高所には触れず、確認したひもだけ準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 範囲外へ触れず指示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will not touch wiring outside my area or anything up high; I will prepare only the cord that has been confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not touch things outside your assignment and will wait for instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その状態でお待ちください。配線確認後、入口横の飾りの指示を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please wait with everything as it is. After the wiring check, we will give instructions for the decoration beside the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: That is eight boxed meals, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。五個と三個で、部署別の二袋にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 総数を保って部署別袋を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Please put them in two bags by department, five in one and three in the other.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Keep the total unchanged and specify department-based bags in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 種類も分かれていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 五個は魚、三個は肉です。全部で八個のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 各袋の種類と数量を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Five are fish and three are meat. The total remains eight.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State the type and quantity for each bag in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 会計は一件でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is one combined payment all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。部署の精算はこちらで後から行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 店会計と社内精算を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. We will settle the departmental costs internally afterwards.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish payment at the shop from internal company reimbursement in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 袋に名前を付けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Shall we label the bags with names?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: Ａ部署とＢ部署でお願いします。個人名は不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 袋の部署名を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Department A and Department B, please. Individual names are not needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Specify the department names for the bags in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二袋の内訳を復唱します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will repeat the contents of the two bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 魚五個がＡ、肉三個がＢです。受取時も別々に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 袋ごとの内訳を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Five fish meals are for A, and three meat meals for B. I will check each bag separately when collecting them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Repeat the breakdown by bag in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 魚五個と肉三個を部署別に包装し、八個分を一括会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: We will pack five fish meals and three meat meals by department and charge for all eight together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 予約は住宅の相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Your booking is for a housing consultation, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。途中で税の話も出そうなので、別担当が必要か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 別分野の担当要否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Tax questions may also come up, so I want to ask whether another specialist is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether another field's specialist is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 内容を大まかに伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you give us a broad outline?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 住宅の契約です。税の判断は自分ではできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 契約と税判断未確定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: It is about a housing contract. I cannot determine the tax implications myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State the contract issue and unresolved tax judgment in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 担当と時間枠を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will check the responsible staff and time slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今の予約を消さず、追加相談の方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 既予約を保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do not cancel the current booking; tell me how to add another consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to keep the existing booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 追加資料はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 契約の写しです。関係する部分を窓口で示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 関連資料を限定提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: A copy of the contract. I will show the relevant portions at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Present only the relevant materials in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 税担当への連絡方法も案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will also explain how to contact the tax staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 住宅の枠で全部解決すると伝えず、必要なら別に予約します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 必要時の別予約に応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will not say everything will be resolved within the housing appointment; I will book separately if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will accept a separate booking if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 既予約を維持して担当へ確認します。住宅相談と税の照会先を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: We will keep the existing booking and check with the responsible staff. We will separately explain the housing consultation and the tax inquiry contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like to check a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 保存した相手ですが、前の金額まで表示されました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 保存金額の残存を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The recipient is saved, but the previous amount appeared too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a saved amount has remained.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: What is the amount this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二万円です。前回の五万円ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 今回額と前回額を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Twenty thousand yen. It is not the previous fifty thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish the current amount from the previous amount in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ実行していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Have you not executed it yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。金額を直して、相手の口座も今回の案内と比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未実行で口座と額を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Correct. I will correct the amount and compare the recipient account with this time's instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it has not been executed and you will compare the account and amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受取人が同じでも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please check even if the recipient is the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。日付も予約になっていないか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予約日も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I also want to see whether the date is set for a scheduled transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check the scheduled date too in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認画面で金額と実行日を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will confirm the amount and execution date on the confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 二万円を今日、という希望です。手数料と合計も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 今回希望と合計確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I want twenty thousand yen transferred today. I will also check the fee and total.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: State this transfer's requirements and the total check in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 実行前に相手、二万円、日付、手数料を見直してください。未確認なら操作を止めて窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Before executing, review the recipient, twenty thousand yen, date, and fee. If anything is unconfirmed, stop the operation and come to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like information about a screening?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 字幕とありますが、何語の音声と字幕ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 音声と字幕言語を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: It says subtitled, but what language are the audio and subtitles in?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about the audio and subtitle languages in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この回の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will check the information for this screening.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 日本語字幕が希望です。字幕という文字だけで買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 希望字幕を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I want Japanese subtitles. I will not buy just because it says “subtitles.”
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State your desired subtitle language clearly in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この回は英語音声、日本語字幕です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: This screening has English audio and Japanese subtitles.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。吹替の回と同じ座席時刻ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 字幕と吹替の回を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. It is not the same screening time and seats as the dubbed version, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish the subtitled and dubbed screenings in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 別の上映です。今回の時刻はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: It is a different screening. Here is the time for this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 六時のこの回を二人分選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 確認回を二人分選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like to choose this six-o'clock screening for two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose the confirmed screening for two people in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 席は並んだ二席でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would two seats together be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。言語と六時の回を確認してその二席にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 言語時刻席を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes. I have checked the language and six-o'clock screening, and will take those two seats.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm the language, time, and seats in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 英語音声、日本語字幕、六時の回の隣り合う二席でお受けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: We will take your booking as two adjacent seats for the six-o'clock screening with English audio and Japanese subtitles.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like advice about collecting a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 不在票にある局へ行きたいですが、そこで保管されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 印刷局での現保管を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I want to go to the post office on the missed-delivery notice, but is the parcel currently being held there?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese whether it is currently held at the printed post office.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 番号で現在の場所を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will check its current location using the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらです。印刷された住所だけで出発しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 番号で調べ出発を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here it is. I will not set out based on the printed address alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Use the number for the inquiry and hold off leaving in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 移送中の場合も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: We also need to check if it is in transit between locations.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日取りに行けるか、受取可能になった案内も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 本日の受取可能状態を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I want to ask whether I can collect it today and about confirmation that it is ready for collection.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether it is available for collection today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受取方法を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will check collection methods with the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 再配達も未申込です。二つを同時に頼まないよう決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二受取方法の重複を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have not requested redelivery either. I will decide so that I do not request both methods at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Avoid duplicate requests for two collection methods in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受取人はご本人ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。窓口受取に決まったら必要な資料を準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 本人受取資料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes. If we decide on counter collection, I will prepare the necessary documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm documents for collecting it yourself in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 場所と状態を確認後、窓口受取か再配達を案内します。今は移動せずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-HIRATSUKA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: After checking the location and status, we will explain counter collection or redelivery. Please wait without going anywhere for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will check the missed-delivery notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一つの注文ですが、二便に分かれて届くそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一注文二便と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is one order, but I am told it will arrive in two separate shipments.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain one order with two shipments in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の番号は何件ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: How many notification numbers are there?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二件です。不在票は一枚だけあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知二件と不在票一件を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are two. I have only one missed-delivery slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State two notifications and one missed-delivery notice in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両方を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。この一枚で二つ再配達とは頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一票で両便を依頼しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. I will not use this one slip to request redelivery of both parcels.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not request both shipments using one slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もう一便は受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you received the other shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。店の発送予定と、配達の状態を分けて調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他便未受取と発送予定を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I want to check the shop's planned dispatch separately from the delivery status.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the unreceived other shipment from the dispatch schedule in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれの番号で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check each number separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず不在票の荷物の受取方法を聞き、もう一便は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二番号の相談を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will ask how to receive the parcel on the missed-delivery notice, and check the other shipment separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the inquiries for the two numbers in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二便を分けて照会します。この不在票の番号から手続きを案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-KAMAKURA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will inquire about the two shipments separately. We will explain the procedure starting with the number on this missed-delivery notice.
